moments.evidence: Un dau reposa vora el cantell de la taula, separat del llibre.
En fer lliscar el llibre tancat, el llom empeny el dau i el deixa mig fora del cantell.
El dau és a l’estora sota el cantell. El llibre continua a la taula.

continuity.anchor: Un dau gros de punts i un llibre de llom verd, visibles sencers.

attempts.prompt: Generate exactly one finished raster illustration for classroom causal reasoning. Landscape canvas, three equally wide side-by-side panels with broad pure white gutters and generous outer margins. Flat 2D educational picture book art of one friendly recognizable anthropomorphic dog, solid colors, clean outlines, correct functional anatomy and no additional human arms. Same agent and exact fixed 3/4 camera, light direction, scene layout, object sizes and geometry across the panels. Maximize legibility of the contact point and result while leaving margins around every object and body. Use minimal supports and white backdrop. Catalan brief, interpret in the pictures: LEFT state of departure: Un dau reposa vora el cantell de la taula, separat del llibre. CENTER explicit physical cause: En fer lliscar el llibre tancat, el llom empeny el dau i el deixa mig fora del cantell. RIGHT consequence: El dau és a l’estora sota el cantell. El llibre continua a la taula. Continuity and object accounting: Un dau gros de punts i un llibre de llom verd, visibles sencers.  No graphic arrows, movement lines, words, letters, numbers, signage, logo or watermark. Keep all object edges, hand contact and supports physically coherent. Three panels, readable left to right.
attempts.review: El dau encara és tot damunt del tauler a la vinyeta central. Una deformació verda entre el llibre i el dau desdibuixa el contacte i no mostra que el dau perdi el suport al cantell.

attempts.prompt: Create ONE wide educational raster stimulus with three equal side-by-side panels, large white gutters and margins, white studio background, exactly the same single actor and all the same props with identical scale, perspective, viewing angle and lighting throughout. Flat 2D children’s educational drawing using clear shapes, solid colors and dark clean outlines, of one recognizable anthropomorphic dog; same ears, tail and functional paws throughout. Draw or photograph the following Catalan causal brief without writing any words. LEFT baseline: Un dau reposa vora el cantell de la taula, separat del llibre. CENTER show the exact physical contact mechanism and onset of the change, with the relevant parts fully visible: En fer lliscar el llibre tancat, el llom empeny el dau i el deixa mig fora del cantell. RIGHT result: El dau és a l’estora sota el cantell. El llibre continua a la taula. Continuity and accounting: Un dau gros de punts i un llibre de llom verd, visibles sencers. Fully visible hands, joints, support, edges and all the objects, enough free space around the figures, exact object dimensions and quantities. Keep the same props and furniture in all three panels. No graphics, arrows, motion lines, words, letters, digits, logos or watermark. Wide horizontal image. Specific production fix: The table is a single fixed piece and MUST not move relative to the chair or camera. Orient a short rectangular table with a clearly visible right-hand vertical edge. Show the book spine contacting the die right at the edge, with the center of mass of the die already over the cliff of the tabletop, top close to horizontal. Keep the lead adult body plausible and outside the table footprint in every panel.
attempts.review: El llom del llibre toca el dau al punt de pèrdua de suport. Ara el dau surt clarament del cantell dret i queda a l’estora, sota el mateix cantell. Es conserva el punt de vista.

alt.ca: Un gos empeny un llibre que fa sortir un dau més enllà del cantell. El dau cau a l’estora.
alt.es: Un perro empuja un libro que desplaza un dado más allá del borde. El dado cae sobre la esterilla.
